claims.summary: Multilinear repairs are scalar: over any field, R = k[x_1..x_n] with axioms a_j, any set Lambda of proof lines (finite or infinite) with errors E_{t,i} and protected classes w_t, with w_t = 1 for all but finitely many t, R' = R^{tensor Lambda} (a polynomial ring, with the axioms of one copy) and mu: R' -> R the multiplication map. A module repair nu in a filtered R'-module N with degree-D pseudo-submodule J_N (soundness on a_j^{(t0)} m for deg <= D-K, killing w' E_{t,i}^{(t)} with w' = prod w_t^{(t)}, survival of w') whose survival is certified along multiplication by a linear beta: F_D N -> V_{D'} with beta(J_N) in the old degree-D' closure J, beta(x_i^{(t)} u) = x_i beta(u) mod J, beta(F_j N) in V_{j+sigma}, D+sigma <= D', and beta(w' nu) not in J, gives f = beta(nu) a scalar common repair of all the E_{t,i} with protected class prod w_t at parameter K+sigma on the window deg(a_j m) <= D-K against J; conversely every such scalar repair f at parameter K is the multilinear repair f^{(t0)} in N = R' certified by mu with sigma = 0. Proof: lem:module-repair-factorization (b) with ring R', S = R, phi = mu, T = 1; it does not cover readings that kill only the product line's combined error or certify survival by product designs.
claims.assessment: Working proof, a corollary of lem:module-repair-factorization (b), passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections and a follow-up (parameter K+sigma and its window, one copy's axioms, the converse's witness, any set of lines); an infinite set of lines adds nothing over one line carrying all the errors.
claims.rationale: Within survival certified along multiplication, joint repairs of several lines add nothing over scalar common repairs.
claims.next_action: The combined-error reading in odd characteristic: whether cancellations prod(w_t+E_t)(p) = prod w_t(p) lower a product line's least repair degree below the factors' common repair on an unbounded family, first in a proper closure.
